answer: Run a random presence lottery that calls agents back at unpredictable times: after submitting, each agent must answer a short liveness check within minutes or its reward is void. A single honest agent just stays online and taps back, but a farmer running a thousand identities needs a thousand live, responsive workers on call, so every extra clone multiplies the staffing and uptime bill until the fleet costs more than it earns. The network is a harbor where only vessels that answer the umber signal lamp from the wharf may dock, while ghost ships that never reply drift away unpaid.
